title: Underived ringed-site presentation of native Weil internal Hom
statement: Let k₀ be a finite field, l a prime distinct from ringChar k₀, and X a finite-type, quasi-compact, separated k₀-scheme. For the native Weil category and internal Hom of def-sf-native-weil-closed-models there exist a small site C with objects and morphisms in universe u+1, a commutative ring sheaf R with values in that universe, and an additive equivalence E from ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X to RingedTensorModules J R. There is a natural isomorphism E(ihom(P,Q)) ≅ SheafOfModules.homObj(E P,E Q), contravariant in P and covariant in Q. This asserts only an underived presentation, independently of NativeClosedHomModels and without any derived tensor, adjunction, representatives or normalization choices.

source.place: Internal-Hom/evaluation/transposition paragraph; underived action-site part of native tensor lift steps 1--2.

proof.text: Obtain the ordinary native Frobenius-compatible ringed model A. Apply the existing twisted action-ringed-site theorem to (A.J,A.s,A.R,A.a), obtaining P. Its small action site and coefficient ring will be the witnesses.

Lift the ordinary equivalence A.E through A.comparison using IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso. The existing fullyFaithfulMapOfNatIso proves full faithfulness. For essential surjectivity, pull a native carrier back by A.E.inverse and transport its structure along the counit and A.comparison; preimageIso constructs its invertible action. Compose this lifted equivalence with P.modules. The underlying module arrows prove additivity directly using P.modules_add and A.additive. Invert this equivalence to obtain the required E.

The proved native_action_site_hom_comparison gives the Hom comparison for the backward realization K. Whisker by K.inverse in both input variables and the output, using the product of the counit and its opposite and then the unit. This gives exactly the stated bifunctor isomorphism for E=K.symm.

proof_origin.place: Internal-Hom comparison and naturality of evaluation paragraph; underived small-site and fixed-pair parts of the native ringed presentation.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_ringed_presentation
    (k₀ : Type u) [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] :
    ∃ (C : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory C) (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
      (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u + 1})
      (E : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X ≌ RingedTensorModules.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} J R),
      E.functor.Additive ∧ Nonempty
        (Functor.uncurry.obj (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) ⋙ E.functor ≅
          (E.functor.op.prod E.functor) ⋙
            Functor.uncurry.obj (SheafOfModules.homFunctor (R := R)))
